content.short: Airwallex is a global business finance platform with multi-currency accounts, cards, FX and cross-border payments.
content.description: Airwallex, founded in 2015 in Melbourne, is a business finance platform that helps companies move and manage money across borders. From one account it offers multi-currency business accounts, local receiving accounts, foreign exchange, global pay-ins and payouts, corporate and virtual cards, expense management and billing. Through its payments APIs, other platforms can embed accounts, cards and transfers for their own customers. Airwallex serves more than 200,000 businesses, including Shein, Qantas and Canva, and processes over 287 billion dollars in payments a year across more than 200 countries.
